Customers fp:2fa4fb649115, fp:40abe5c7e9f1 and fp:8c5e0de9ca46 are marked under review and have a case open, but got no notice. The requester has to give a new release before they can be sent one. No call may be retried under release fp:91c9c81b7804.
The 97 other sending calls were not traced. A full outbox count under the release would settle C10 for all 100.

Neither the library nor the record can tell a preview from a real send, because both carry the same label. ELEF may want previews either labelled apart or kept from using up a customer's call under a release.
